messages.author: 544a2f5526cc67ef
messages.subject: setColorMaps() error
parts:
Did anyone else get this error?

victoria
===============================
fit(plm, verbose=verbose);
rs = calculateResiduals(plm, verbose=verbose)
ae = ArrayExplorer(rs)
> setColorMaps(ae, c("log2neg,rainbow", "log2pos,rainbow"));
Error in addColorMap.ArrayExplorer(this, colorMap, ...) :
object "nbrOfColors" not found

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] setColorMaps() error
parts:
Hi,

this is a bug. A workaround for now is to do:

nbrOfColors <- 256

before calling setColorMaps().

FYI, I've fixed this bug for the next release.

/Henrik
